q1_issues.issue: (Location sk_want_1 sk_lantern_1) attaches 'at its lanterns' to the wanting event, asserting that the village does its wanting at the lanterns, when the PP predicates the location of the desired nightmoths.

q2_gaps: desire verb with a small-clause complement ('wants nightmoths at its lanterns' = wants them to be at the lanterns): the instruction set covers a psych verb with an entity object (Experiencer/Stimulus), a finite that-clause (seal), a control to-infinitive and a perception eventive complement, but supplies no carrier for a locative/adjectival small clause predicated of the object
notes: The rest is doctrinal: definite singular witness, want as stative psych (Experiencer/Stimulus), possessed plural 'its lanterns' as a group witness with Possession, and night_moth decomposed to genus moth with the noun modifier unexposed.
